source.subject: 璃・・What's New: $15k MRR in a boring niche, selling your internal tools, stop getting told what to do

raw_signal: $15k MRR in a boring niche / selling internal tools / vibe coding tools are gaining attention among indie builders.

pain: They do not know what to build, and they waste time chasing broad AI ideas instead of boring, specific, monetizable niches.
why_now: AI coding tools make it easier for solo builders to turn narrow workflow problems or internal tools into public products quickly.
first_product: A report or lightweight tool that converts real indie business signals into 10 buildable boring-niche SaaS ideas with buyer, pain, price, and validation plan.
price: $19-$29 one-time for a report, then $19-$49/month for ongoing access.
distribution: Indie Hackers, X, Product Hunt, Reddit r/SaaS, Reddit r/indiehackers, build-in-public accounts.
lead_magnet_angle: 10 boring AI SaaS ideas you can build this weekend.
content_angle: The best AI business ideas are not flashy. They are boring workflows with clear buyers.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion turns indie business signals into buildable product prompts, so builders stop guessing what to build.
